notes.title: Release ver.1.02 Labyrinth of the Chaka King
notes.notes:
Until now, only the operation guide on the keyboard was displayed.

In this update,
When operating with a gamepad, I try to give guidance for operating the gamepad.
When you operate the keyboard, it will immediately switch to the keyboard operation guide display.
The keyboard operation guide has been changed from letters to icons.

However, the game pad operation guide is
Complies with the buttons on the Xbox controller.

I made it a little easier to play.
Enjoy the Labyrinth of King Chaka.

notes.title: Release ver.1.01 Labyrinth of the Chaka King
notes.notes:
When selecting a room by title and entering the room,
It was inconvenient because I could not see the screenshot of the room,
Improved to display a screenshot of the selected room.

It’s a little easier to play, so
Please aim for the Labyrinth Master of King Chaka.
